label: The Empty Cabin
summary: Halfway across the Atlantic a passenger vanishes from a cabin locked from the inside. The captain asks you to find out how.
title: The Empty Cabin
description: On the second night aboard the Aurelia, the financier Lionel Ashworth vanished from his cabin, which was locked from the inside, two thousand feet above the ocean. The captain cannot turn back and cannot call the police. He has asked you to find out what happened before the ship lands in New York.

chapterOutlines.title: Cabin 14
chapterOutlines.outline: Examine the locked cabin and what was left behind.

chapterOutlines.title: The Passengers
chapterOutlines.outline: Question the guests, the crew and the stowaway nobody admits exists.

chapterOutlines.title: Over the Clouds
chapterOutlines.outline: A second crime raises the stakes.

chapterOutlines.title: Landfall
chapterOutlines.outline: Gather everyone in the ballroom and name the truth before New York.

scene.location: Corridor B on the Aurelia, outside Cabin 14, at two in the morning
scene.summary: The steward has the master key in a shaking hand. The captain is waiting. Behind the door, nothing but the hum of the engines.

openThreads: How do you leave a locked room on an airship?

npcs.name: Captain Henrik Lund
npcs.description: The Aurelia's Norwegian captain, who has never lost a passenger and is quietly furious about it.
goals: Land in New York without a scandal

npcs.name: Vivienne Marchetti
npcs.description: A glamorous film star traveling under a false name, who was seen arguing with Ashworth at dinner.
goals: Keep her real name out of the papers

npcs.name: Arthur Pym
npcs.description: The missing man's secretary, who seems more relieved than worried.
goals: Find a certain document before anyone else does

items.name: Passenger list
items.description: Forty names, six of them false.

items.name: Notebook
